name: What-If Flat Vector
description: 2D flat vector night-world animation identity featuring a minimalist black stick figure in a locked bright red hoodie.
system_instructions:
**Visual Aesthetic:** Flat vector 2D night-world animation identity featuring clean geometric shapes, minimal silhouettes, zero gradients, and high visual contrast. The visual world is built on stark dark navy night palettes punctuated by warm glowing windows and soft streetlight pools, creating an atmospheric, minimalist animated story aesthetic.

**Human Subjects:** Minimalist black stick figure character featuring a perfectly round solid black head, tiny bright white dot eyes, and a bright RED hoodie. The hoodie color is strictly locked to vibrant bright red across every scene—never any other color. The figure has thin solid black limbs of EXACTLY uniform thickness across all four limbs (approximately 1/20 the diameter of the head), never tapered, and never thicker or thinner on one limb than another. Expressive posture and body language convey emotional tone with complete clarity.

**Environment & Architecture:** Clean, simplified geometric architecture and environmental silhouettes set against deep night. Buildings, houses, streets, rooms, and outdoor terrain are rendered with flat minimal geometric planes, sharp edges, and clean vector shapes. Interiors feature sparse furnishings and clean focal compositions, maintaining complete spatial clarity without clutter or distracting detail.

**Lighting & Atmosphere:** Dark navy night worlds with moody, localized illumination. Deep midnight navy blue and charcoal tones dominate the sky and shadowed geometry. Light sources are strictly localized: warm golden glowing windows, subtle streetlights, or soft interior lighting casting clean flat geometric shapes. Zero gradients; lighting is conveyed purely through crisp flat color blocks and contrasting values.

**Camera & Framing:** 16:9 widescreen layout with flat 2D theatrical framing and graphic cinematic composition. Seamlessly shifts between wide establishing shots capturing the quiet nocturnal landscape and medium focus shots tracking the red-hooded protagonist. Clean negative space and strong visual hierarchy ensure key narrative actions remain front and center.

**STRICTLY AVOID:** 3D rendering, gradients, photorealism, textures, complex shading, any hoodie color other than bright red, non-uniform limb thickness, tapered limbs, facial features beyond white dot eyes, digital noise, blurry artifacts, messy sketch lines, drop shadows, or text overlays.
